en.t: The reply consisted of only two lines of verse.

units.source_text: 他看看送回来的腰带，知道是头中将之物，

en.t: He looked at the sash that had been sent back and realized it belonged to the Captain Secretary,

units.source_text: 因为这腰带的颜色比他自己的常礼服深[\[21\]](#part1336.html#m21)。

en.t: because its color was darker than that of his own everyday court robe[\[21\]](#part1336.html#m21).

units.source_text: 但检点自己的常礼服，发见假袖[\[22\]](#part1336.html#m22)已经撕掉。

en.t: But when he examined his own everyday court robe, he discovered that the false sleeve[\[22\]](#part1336.html#m22) had already been torn off.

units.source_text: 可见渔色之人，丢脸的事一定很多。”

en.t: Clearly, people who chase after women must often end up embarrassing themselves."
The more he thought about it, the more cautious he became.
